intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on an exclusive private dhoni boat cruise at sunset, where you can spot spinner dolphins dancing in the golden waters. Sip champagne with your partner as the sky turns shades of orange and pink, creating an unforgettable romantic moment on the Indian Ocean.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant house reefs and coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to the most pristine underwater spots across multiple reef systems, perfect for couples who love marine life.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa experience at a glass-walled underwater treatment room, where you can watch colorful fish glide past while enjoying traditional Maldivian massages using coconut oil and local botanicals. The ultimate luxury honeymoon pampering session.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded white sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon, where a personal chef prepares a gourmet Maldivian seafood feast just for two. Dine barefoot on fresh grilled lobster, tuna curry, and tropical fruits surrounded by nothing but ocean.
experiences.location: Veligandu Island, North Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village & Bodu Beru Night
experiences.description: Visit the local island of Maafushi to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore traditional fishing villages, visit a local mosque, try handmade lacquerwork crafts, and taste street-style short eats like bajiya and gulha. End the evening watching the hypnotic Bodu Beru drum dance performance under the stars.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village & Bodu Beru Night
experiences.description: Visit the local island of Maafushi to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore traditional fishing villages, visit a local mosque, try handmade lacquerwork crafts, and taste street-style short eats like bajiya and gulha. End the evening watching the hypnotic Bodu Beru drum dance performance under the stars.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs. Arrange pre-booked speedboat or ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront room, freshen up, and enjoy the sound of the ocean from your room.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Grab a light snack or meal at the airport before departure or pick up something from the resort's late-night room service if available. Budget option: airport convenience store snacks (~$5–10).

day_by_day.notes: Keep your transfer confirmation handy. Speedboat transfers at night can be chilly — pack a light jacket. Confirm resort check-in time in advance for late arrivals. Rest well for an exciting first full day tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up to your first Maldivian sunrise from your beachfront room. After breakfast, take a leisurely walk along the resort beach to get your bearings. Rent snorkeling gear from the resort or a nearby local shop (budget tip: local island shops are 50–70% cheaper) and explore the house reef just off the beachfront — ideal for spotting colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and coral formations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the nearest local island by public ferry or dhoni (traditional boat) for an affordable afternoon excursion. Explore the island's streets, visit a local café, and browse small shops for Maldivian souvenirs like lacquerware and woven mats. This gives you an authentic cultural contrast to the resort experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort before sunset. Watch the golden sunset from the beach with your partner — bring a sarong and sit on the sand for a romantic, free experience. Enjoy dinner at the resort's casual beach restaurant or grill.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet if included, or order à la carte — opt for eggs, toast, and fresh tropical fruit (~$8–12 if not included).
meals.lunch: Local island café lunch — try mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi flatbread (~$4–7 per person).
meals.dinner: Resort beachside grill — grilled fish or chicken with rice and salad (~$15–20 per person). Share dishes to save costs.

day_by_day.notes: Buy or rent snorkel gear locally to save money. Apply reef-safe sunscreen to protect coral ecosystems. Public ferry schedules vary — check timings the night before.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef during the calmest water conditions. Look out for blacktip reef sharks, manta rays, and parrotfish. After snorkeling, enjoy a slow breakfast and relax on the beachfront with a book or simply soak in the tropical ambiance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget-friendly group snorkeling boat trip (often available for $25–40 per person from local operators) to nearby coral reefs and sandbanks. These group tours often include snorkeling at 2–3 different reef spots and are far more affordable than private resort excursions.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic evening stroll along the beach as the stars emerge — the Maldives has minimal light pollution, making stargazing spectacular. Enjoy a candlelit dinner at the resort or a nearby guesthouse restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruit platter, yogurt, and coffee at the resort (~$8 if not included).
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or snacks brought on the boat trip — buy from a local bakery: samosas, tuna rolls, and bottled water (~$5).
meals.dinner: Candlelit dinner at the resort's beachside restaurant — fresh grilled catch of the day with coconut rice (~$18–22 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Book the group snorkeling trip through a local guesthouse or local tour operator rather than the resort to save significantly. Bring biodegradable sunscreen, a waterproof phone case, and reef shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Visit the Maldivian Cultural Village on the local island of Maafushi (or nearest cultural island accessible by ferry). Explore traditional fishing villages, visit a mosque, and learn about the history of Maldivian boat building (dhoni craftsmanship). This is a deeply enriching and largely free cultural experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in the Bodu Beru Night experience — a traditional Maldivian drumming and dance performance that typically takes place in the evenings but can sometimes be arranged in the afternoon at cultural centers. Alternatively, spend the afternoon at a local island beach (free public beaches available on most local islands) for relaxed swimming and sunbathing.
day_by_day.evening: Stay on the local island for the Bodu Beru Night performance — an electrifying cultural show featuring traditional drumming, chanting, and dance that builds to a frenetic crescendo. This is often free or very low cost (~$5–10). Return to resort by last ferry or arranged dhoni.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local bakery on the island — tuna pastry and tea (~$3–5).
meals.lunch: Local island restaurant — hedhikaa (Maldivian short eats) platter with fish curry and rice (~$5–8).
meals.dinner: Local island restaurant dinner before the Bodu Beru show — grilled fish, curry, and coconut-based dishes (~$8–12 per person).

day_by_day.notes: This is the highlight cultural experience of the trip. Dress modestly when visiting local islands — cover shoulders and knees out of respect. Check ferry schedules carefully to avoid being stranded after the evening show.

day_by_day.morning: Lazy morning — sleep in and enjoy the beachfront at your own pace. Take a morning swim in the crystal-clear lagoon directly from your beachfront accommodation. Practice snorkeling techniques if you're a beginner or explore deeper reef sections if experienced.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a kayak or stand-up paddleboard (SUP) from the resort or a local operator (~$10–15/hour) and paddle around the lagoon. Explore the shallow turquoise waters, spot marine life from above, and paddle to a nearby sandbank if accessible. This is a wonderfully romantic and active afternoon activity.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private sunset cruise for two with a local dhoni operator — far cheaper than resort-arranged sunset cruises (~$30–50 for a private dhoni vs. $100+ through the resort). Watch the sun dip below the Indian Ocean horizon while sipping on fresh coconut water.

meals.breakfast: Sleep-in brunch — resort eggs benedict or pancakes with fresh Maldivian papaya (~$10–14).
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch — fresh coconut, fruit skewers, and a sandwich from the resort snack bar (~$8–10).
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner at the resort — request a beach table for two with candles. Grilled lobster or reef fish (splurge-worthy once) with tropical salad (~$25–35 per person as a special treat).

day_by_day.notes: The sunset dhoni cruise is best booked through local guesthouse operators or by negotiating directly with fishermen at the harbor. Bring a camera for golden hour photography — the colors are extraordinary.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin watching excursion — book through a local operator for a group trip (~$20–30 per person). Spinner dolphins are commonly seen in Maldivian waters in the early morning. The sight of dolphins leaping alongside the boat is truly magical and deeply romantic.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from the dolphin trip and spend a relaxed afternoon at the resort beach. Build sandcastles, read, nap in a hammock, or simply float in the warm lagoon. This is your designated rest and recharge afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the local island night market if available, or explore the resort's evening entertainment. Many resorts offer free cultural evenings, movie nights on the beach, or stargazing sessions. Enjoy a quiet evening walk along the shoreline.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the dolphin trip — banana, granola bar, and coffee (~$4–6 or free if resort breakfast is included).
meals.lunch: Post-excursion resort lunch — fish tacos or a fresh salad bowl (~$10–14).
meals.dinner: Local guesthouse restaurant for a budget-friendly authentic dinner — tuna curry, rice, and papadum (~$7–10 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed but are very common in the Maldives. Go with realistic expectations and enjoy the boat ride regardless. Bring seasickness tablets if you're prone to motion sickness on open water.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day snorkeling excursion to a famous reef or marine protected area — book as a group day trip through a local operator (~$40–60 per person including lunch). Visit multiple snorkeling spots known for manta rays, whale sharks (seasonal), and vibrant coral gardens.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the full-day snorkeling trip — afternoon spots often include shallower, calmer reefs perfect for leisurely exploration. Snorkel alongside tropical fish schools, moray eels, and sea turtles in their natural habitat.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort in the late afternoon. Rinse off, relax, and enjoy a quiet, romantic evening. Write postcards, journal about your experiences, or simply sit together watching the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast before departure (~$8–12 or included).
meals.lunch: Included in the day trip — typically a fresh Maldivian lunch served on a sandbank or local island (~included in tour price).
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — keep it simple with a shared pizza or pasta dish to balance the day's splurge (~$12–16 per person).

day_by_day.notes: This is the most immersive snorkeling day of the trip. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro. Apply sunscreen generously — you'll be in the water for hours. Stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed morning yoga or stretching session on the beach — many resorts offer free or low-cost morning yoga (~$5–10). Alternatively, practice on your own using a free app on the beachfront. This is a wonderful way to connect as a couple and start the day mindfully.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore underwater photography — rent an underwater camera housing (~$15–20/day) or use a waterproof phone case and spend the afternoon snorkeling and documenting the marine life you've been seeing all week. Create lasting memories of your honeymoon underwater world.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private beach picnic for two — ask the resort to prepare a picnic basket or source items from a local shop (fresh fruit, cheese, crackers, juice) and set up your own romantic spread on the beach as the sun sets (~$15–25 DIY vs. $80+ resort-arranged).

meals.breakfast: Light post-yoga breakfast — smoothie bowl with tropical fruits, granola, and honey (~$8–10).
meals.lunch: Local island lunch — fresh grilled fish with coconut rice at a small family-run restaurant (~$6–9 per person).
meals.dinner: DIY beach picnic — fresh tropical fruits, local cheese, crackers, tuna salad, and sparkling juice under the stars (~$20–30 total for two).

day_by_day.notes: The DIY beach picnic is one of the most romantic and budget-friendly evening experiences you can create. Bring a Bluetooth speaker with soft music, a blanket, and fairy lights if you packed them.

day_by_day.morning: Take a day trip to a nearby uninhabited island — arrange with a local fisherman or dhoni operator for a drop-off and pickup (~$15–25 per person). Spend the morning completely alone on a pristine, deserted island — swim, snorkel, sunbathe, and revel in the extraordinary privacy and natural beauty.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring the uninhabited island — collect shells, explore the interior vegetation, look for hermit crabs and shorebirds. This is the ultimate romantic, off-the-beaten-path Maldives experience that costs a fraction of private island resort rates.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Enjoy a long, hot shower and treat yourselves to a couples' massage at the resort spa — look for promotional packages or shorter 30-minute sessions to keep costs manageable (~$40–60 for a 30-min couples' session).

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before departure (~$8–12 or included).
meals.lunch: Packed picnic lunch on the uninhabited island — prepare the night before or buy from a local bakery: sandwiches, fruit, nuts, and water (~$8–12 for two).
meals.dinner: Post-spa resort dinner — treat yourselves to a slightly nicer meal to celebrate the day. Grilled seafood platter to share (~$20–28 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Negotiate the uninhabited island trip directly with local fishermen at the harbor for the best rates. Bring plenty of water, sunscreen, a first aid kit, and a fully charged phone. Agree on a pickup time clearly.

day_by_day.morning: Morning visit to a local fishing village to witness the traditional Maldivian way of life. Watch fishermen return with their catch, visit the fish market, and learn about the pole-and-line fishing tradition that sustains Maldivian communities. This is a free, authentic cultural experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cooking class at a local guesthouse — learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes like mas riha (tuna curry), garudhiya (fish broth), and bondibai (rice pudding). Many guesthouses offer informal cooking sessions (~$15–25 per person). Take the recipes home as a lasting honeymoon memory.
day_by_day.evening: Eat the meal you cooked together for dinner — the most romantic and personal dining experience of the trip. Enjoy your homemade Maldivian feast at the guesthouse or pack it back to enjoy on the resort beach.

meals.breakfast: Local island breakfast — roshi (flatbread) with tuna and coconut chutney at a local café (~$3–5).
meals.lunch: Light snack at the fish market area — fresh grilled tuna skewers (~$2–4).
meals.dinner: Your own homemade Maldivian cooking class meal — priceless and included in the class cost.

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class is a wonderful way to bring Maldivian culture home with you. Ask your instructor for a handwritten recipe card as a souvenir. Many local guesthouses are happy to accommodate this request.

day_by_day.morning: Final serious snorkeling day — revisit your favorite reef spot from the week. Now that you're experienced and comfortable in the water, take time to observe marine behavior more carefully: watch parrotfish nibble coral, follow a turtle's graceful path, or observe a reef shark patrol its territory.
day_by_day.afternoon: Beach relaxation and souvenir shopping on the local island. Pick up handcrafted Maldivian lacquerware, woven dhivehi mats, locally produced coconut oil, and small reef-themed keepsakes. Support local artisans and negotiate respectfully for fair prices.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic farewell-to-paradise dinner — choose the best restaurant you've visited during the trip and return for a final celebratory meal. Dress up slightly, order something special, and toast to your honeymoon and each other.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — full spread to fuel the final snorkeling session (~$8–12 or included).
meals.lunch: Local island lunch — fresh coconut water, grilled fish, and rice (~$6–8 per person).
meals.dinner: Best restaurant of the trip revisited — budget for a slightly elevated spend (~$20–30 per person) as a honeymoon celebration.

day_by_day.notes: Keep souvenirs lightweight and within airline carry-on limits. Coral, shells, and certain marine items may be restricted from export — stick to certified local crafts. Check airline baggage policies.

day_by_day.morning: Slow, nostalgic final morning. Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach — sit together, watch the sky transform, and soak in the beauty of your last full day in paradise. Take photos, write in a travel journal, and simply be present.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final swim in the lagoon and house reef snorkel. Pack non-essential items and begin organizing luggage. Spend the late afternoon relaxing at the resort pool or beach, reflecting on the incredible experiences of the past 12 days.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset walk along the beach — collect a small jar of Maldivian sand as a free, meaningful keepsake. Enjoy a final casual dinner at the resort. Early bedtime to prepare for departure day.

meals.breakfast: Special final morning breakfast — order your favorite items from the week (~$10–14 or included).
meals.lunch: Light resort lunch — fresh salad, grilled fish wrap, and fresh juice (~$10–12).
meals.dinner: Casual resort dinner — keep it simple and affordable. Pasta, pizza, or a sharing platter (~$12–16 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Confirm checkout time, transfer arrangements, and flight details this evening. Set multiple alarms for departure day. Leave a review for local operators and guesthouses who made your trip special — it means a great deal to small businesses.

day_by_day.morning: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Arrange resort-to-airport transfer (book in advance — compare resort shuttle vs. local speedboat/ferry for cost savings). Arrive at Velana International Airport with ample time. Enjoy a final Maldivian meal at the airport or a nearby café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport departure procedures — immigration, security, and boarding. Browse duty-free for any last-minute gifts. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days of snorkeling, romance, culture, and natural beauty in one of the world's most breathtaking destinations.
day_by_day.evening: Departure flight. Settle in, rest, and begin planning your next adventure together — you've successfully experienced the Maldives on a budget without sacrificing beauty, romance, or unforgettable memories.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast or airport café — eggs, toast, and coffee (~$8–12).
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café — keep it light for travel comfort (~$10–15).
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport snacks depending on departure time.

day_by_day.notes: Budget summary tip: By staying at a guesthouse-style beachfront resort, using local ferries, booking excursions through local operators, and eating at local restaurants, a couple can experience 13 days in the Maldives for approximately $150–220/day total (accommodation + food + activities), compared to $500–1500+/day at a traditional overwater bungalow resort. The memories will be just as magical.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs, then meet your Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, enjoy a welcome drink and a light welcome amenity prepared by the resort.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or airport)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in-flight or airport)
meals.dinner: Light late-night welcome snack platter and tropical fruit basket provided at check-in by Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy on your private beachfront terrace with a complimentary welcome cocktail

day_by_day.notes: Given the 22:30 arrival, no excursions or activities are scheduled. Rest and settle in. Confirm all upcoming bookings with the resort concierge upon check-in. Keep luggage light for the transfer — speedboat transfers can be breezy at night.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start to your honeymoon. Take a romantic morning stroll along the private beachfront at Aegean Bliss Resort, watching the sunrise over the Indian Ocean. Explore your villa and the resort grounds at a relaxed pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's main pool or beachfront for a relaxing afternoon. Rent snorkeling gear from the resort's water sports center and explore the house reef just off the beach — your first taste of the Maldives' incredible underwater world with colorful coral and tropical fish.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy your first proper resort dinner together. Watch the sunset from the resort's overwater bar with cocktails before heading to dinner.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — enjoy fresh tropical fruits, pastries, eggs made to order, and Maldivian-style fish curry. Included with your stay.
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch at the resort's beach grill — try the grilled fish of the day sandwich or a fresh prawn salad (approx. USD 25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main à la carte restaurant — opt for the seafood platter or grilled lobster with a glass of house wine. Romantic table by the water (approx. USD 60–80 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally relaxed to recover from travel. Visit the concierge desk after breakfast to confirm bookings for all upcoming experiences. Apply reef-safe sunscreen before any water activities — mandatory at the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — Join this guided snorkeling excursion exploring the vibrant house reefs and coral gardens surrounding the resort. Spot sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and hundreds of tropical fish species. Equipment and a certified guide are provided. Duration approximately 2.5–3 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and unwind on your private beachfront. Enjoy the calm lagoon waters with a paddleboard or kayak rented from the water sports center. Take a nap or read on the beach under a palm-thatched umbrella.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise — Embark on an exclusive private dhoni boat cruise at sunset. Sail into the open ocean to spot playful spinner dolphins dancing in the golden light. Sip on champagne and canapés as the sun dips below the horizon. Duration approximately 2 hours.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort restaurant — fuel up before the morning snorkeling safari with a hearty spread
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood lunch at the resort's beachside café — try the tuna tataki or grilled mahi-mahi wrap with a fresh lime soda (approx. USD 25–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant after returning from the dolphin cruise — enjoy the romantic ambiance with ocean views and a set menu of Maldivian-inspired dishes (approx. USD 70–90 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari and Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise can be booked as a combined day through the resort concierge. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro for the snorkeling safari. The dolphin cruise timing is weather-dependent — confirm the departure time the morning of.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — Begin your morning with this extraordinary couples' spa experience in a glass-walled underwater treatment room. Watch colorful marine life swim past as you enjoy synchronized massages, aromatherapy, and body scrubs. Duration approximately 2 hours. One of the most romantic experiences in the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the spa, enjoy a peaceful afternoon at the resort's infinity pool overlooking the lagoon. Order tropical cocktails and enjoy the serene atmosphere. Alternatively, book a private yoga session on the beach (available through the resort, approx. USD 40–60 per couple).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic evening at the resort's overwater bar. Watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean and enjoy the bioluminescent plankton that often lights up the shoreline at night. Take a romantic barefoot walk along the beach.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — order a special honeymoon breakfast delivered to your beachfront terrace. Enjoy fresh juices, tropical fruits, eggs, and pastries as the sun rises over the ocean (approx. USD 30–40 per couple, or included in some packages)
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — fresh salads, wraps, and chilled smoothies at the pool bar (approx. USD 20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's specialty restaurant — try the tasting menu featuring Maldivian-inspired dishes with Asian influences. Pair with a bottle of white wine (approx. USD 80–100 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment well in advance as slots fill quickly, especially for honeymooners. Request the honeymoon package at the spa for complimentary rose petals and champagne. Spa treatments are best enjoyed on a lighter stomach — schedule breakfast before or a light snack after.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided sunrise kayaking session around the resort's lagoon. Paddle through the calm turquoise waters as the sky turns golden — a magical and intimate experience. Return to the resort for a relaxed breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining — Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded white sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon. A private table, gourmet picnic, chilled wine, and personalized service await you on this deserted strip of white sand surrounded by nothing but ocean. Duration approximately 3–4 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the late afternoon. Enjoy a quiet evening — take a sunset swim in the lagoon, then freshen up for a relaxed dinner.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort restaurant — enjoy a wide spread before the kayaking session
meals.lunch: Included in the Private Sandbank Picnic Dining experience — gourmet Maldivian and international dishes, fresh seafood, tropical fruits, and chilled wine served on the sandbank (experience cost approx. USD 200–280 per couple)
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's beachfront grill — enjoy grilled fish, seafood skewers, and local curries in a relaxed open-air setting (approx. USD 50–70 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic is a highlight experience — book it through the resort concierge at least 2 days in advance. Bring sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses as there is no shade on the sandbank. The speedboat ride is part of the experience — typically 10–20 minutes each way.

day_by_day.morning: Maldivian Cultural Village & Bodu Beru Night — Begin with a morning visit to the local island of Maafushi (accessible by resort speedboat, approx. 20–30 minutes). Explore traditional fishing villages, visit a local mosque, browse handicraft shops, and learn about Maldivian history and daily life with a guided tour.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Maafushi — enjoy lunch at a local café for an authentic and affordable Maldivian meal. Browse the local market for souvenirs such as lacquerware, woven mats, and handmade jewelry. Return to the resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Bodu Beru Night — Experience the electrifying traditional Maldivian Bodu Beru drum performance on Maafushi or at a cultural center. Watch local performers in traditional costumes beat drums and dance in an increasingly hypnotic rhythm. A truly unique cultural experience.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort before departing for Maafushi
meals.lunch: Authentic Maldivian lunch at a local café on Maafushi — try mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), roshi (flatbread), and fresh fish curry. Budget-friendly at approx. USD 10–15 per person
meals.dinner: Dinner back at the resort after the cultural evening — enjoy the resort's Asian fusion restaurant with a lighter meal (approx. USD 55–75 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Maafushi is a local inhabited island — dress modestly when exploring the village (shoulders and knees covered out of respect). The resort concierge can arrange a guided cultural tour package that includes transportation, the village tour, and the Bodu Beru performance. Check the schedule for Bodu Beru performances as they are sometimes held on specific evenings.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint rest and rejuvenation day. Enjoy a slow morning — sleep in, order in-villa breakfast, and spend quality time together on your private beachfront. Take a leisurely swim in the calm lagoon waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's spa for individual treatments — choose from a deep tissue massage, traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage, or a rejuvenating facial. Spend the rest of the afternoon at the infinity pool.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic overwater sunset cocktails at the resort's signature bar. Watch the sky transform into shades of orange and pink before heading to a special dinner.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast on your private terrace — a luxurious mid-trip treat
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the resort — fresh salads, grilled fish, and tropical juices (approx. USD 25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Special honeymoon dinner at the resort's most romantic restaurant — request a private table with candle lighting and rose petal decoration. Enjoy a 3-course set menu with wine pairing (approx. USD 100–130 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is your midpoint — take it easy and recharge. This is a good day to review your remaining itinerary with the concierge and make any adjustments. Ask the resort about any complimentary honeymoon perks such as a cake, room decoration, or turndown service.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning guided diving or advanced snorkeling session at a nearby dive site — the resort's dive center can arrange a guided trip to explore deeper coral walls, swim-throughs, and encounter larger marine life including eagle rays and nurse sharks. Non-divers can do a beginner PADI Discover Scuba session (approx. USD 80–120 per person).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and relax. Visit the resort's boutique for any souvenirs or resort wear. Spend the afternoon in a hammock over the water or on the beach with a good book.
day_by_day.evening: Second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (evening session if available) or a guided night snorkeling experience — explore the reef after dark with underwater torches to spot sleeping fish, octopus, and bioluminescent creatures. A truly magical and unique experience.

meals.breakfast: Early buffet breakfast before the morning dive session — high-energy foods like eggs, whole grains, and fresh fruit
meals.lunch: Beachside lunch at the resort grill — grilled lobster roll or fresh tuna salad (approx. USD 25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant with a view of the lit-up lagoon — enjoy fresh catch of the day with Maldivian spices and coconut rice (approx. USD 60–80 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Do not dive within 24 hours of any planned flight. If you plan to dive on Day 8, ensure your departure is not within 24 hours of this activity. Consult the resort dive center for safety guidelines. Night snorkeling requires a guide — book through the resort's water sports desk.

day_by_day.morning: Explore the resort's overwater bungalow area on a guided resort tour, or rent a bicycle and cycle around the island. Visit the resort's marine biology center (if available) to learn about coral restoration efforts and the local ecosystem.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining (second visit or alternative sandbank) — if you loved Day 5's experience, revisit a different sandbank location for a variation. Alternatively, enjoy a private catamaran sailing trip around the atoll (book through resort, approx. USD 150–200 per couple).
day_by_day.evening: Romantic stargazing session on the beach — the Maldives offers some of the clearest night skies in the world. Lay on beach loungers and identify constellations together. Some resorts offer guided astronomy sessions with telescopes.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort restaurant
meals.lunch: Included in the sandbank picnic or catamaran experience, or a light lunch at the poolside café (approx. USD 20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant — enjoy the sound of the ocean beneath you while dining on fresh seafood and tropical desserts (approx. USD 70–90 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: The stargazing experience is best on nights with a new moon when the sky is darkest. Ask the concierge about the moon phase and any scheduled astronomy events. Bring a light wrap or shawl for the evening as ocean breezes can be cool after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Morning water sports session — try jet skiing, wakeboarding, or windsurfing at the resort's water sports center. These activities are great for an adrenaline boost mid-trip. Alternatively, take a stand-up paddleboard yoga class on the lagoon (approx. USD 30–50 per person).
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax and recharge at the resort's spa lounge or beach club. Enjoy complimentary resort amenities such as the sauna, steam room, or jacuzzi. Take a long swim in the lagoon and soak up the afternoon sun.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise (second experience) — if you want to relive the magic, book a second private sunset cruise. The Maldivian sunsets are never the same twice, and spinner dolphins are frequently spotted in the evenings.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — enjoy a final in-villa morning meal on your terrace before a more active day
meals.lunch: Beach picnic lunch prepared by the resort — a basket with sandwiches, fresh fruit, and cold drinks enjoyed on the beach (can be arranged through the concierge, approx. USD 30–40 per couple)
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's specialty seafood restaurant — fresh catch prepared in various styles (grilled, curried, or ceviche). Pair with a tropical cocktail (approx. USD 70–90 per couple)

day_by_day.notes: Water sports activities are best in the morning when winds are calmer. Book the sunset dolphin cruise by midday to secure a spot. Some water sports may require a signed waiver — check with the water sports desk in the morning.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (third session or a different reef location) — explore a new section of the reef or a nearby coral garden by boat. This time, focus on photography — bring an underwater camera to capture the vibrant marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's overwater hammock lounge or rent a private overwater cabana for the afternoon. Enjoy chilled drinks, ocean views, and the ultimate Maldivian relaxation experience. Take a final long swim in the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Maldivian Cultural Night at the resort — many resorts host weekly cultural evenings with traditional food, music, and dance performances. Enjoy a Maldivian buffet featuring local dishes and watch traditional Bodu Beru or Bandiyaa (pot dance) performances.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the overwater cabana — order from the resort's menu and have it delivered (approx. USD 25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Maldivian Cultural Night buffet at the resort — a special spread of local Maldivian cuisine including tuna dishes, coconut-based curries, fresh seafood, and traditional sweets (approx. USD 50–70 per couple, sometimes included in resort packages)

day_by_day.notes: Day 11 is a great day for reflection and appreciation of the Maldives' natural beauty. Begin thinking about any last-minute souvenir shopping. Confirm your departure logistics with the concierge — transfer times, luggage handling, and checkout procedures for Day 13.

day_by_day.morning: Final Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — book a second couples' spa session to mark the end of your honeymoon in the most indulgent way. Choose a different treatment package such as a hot stone massage or a Maldivian coconut and frangipani body wrap.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last afternoon at the beach — spend quality time together on your private beachfront. Take photos, collect memories, and enjoy the turquoise lagoon one final time. Take a farewell snorkeling session on the house reef.
day_by_day.evening: Special farewell dinner — arrange a private beach dinner through the resort concierge. A table set on the sand with torches, candles, rose petals, and a personalized menu. This is your final romantic evening in the Maldives — make it unforgettable.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — enjoy the full spread one more time
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch — light and fresh, saving appetite for the special farewell dinner. Fresh fruit platter, fish tacos, and tropical juice (approx. USD 20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner — a curated 4-course menu with wine pairing, personalized by the resort's chef. Features fresh seafood, Maldivian-inspired dishes, and a special honeymoon dessert (approx. USD 150–200 per couple). Book at least 2 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: The private beach dinner is the crown jewel of your trip — book it well in advance and communicate any dietary preferences or allergies to the resort chef. Request a honeymoon cake or dessert dedication for a truly special touch. Pack your bags tonight to make the morning departure stress-free.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk on the beach — wake up early for one last sunrise over the Indian Ocean. Take photos, breathe in the salt air, and cherish the final moments in paradise. Enjoy a leisurely last breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Complete checkout formalities at Aegean Bliss Resort. The concierge will arrange your speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Velana International Airport (Male). Arrive at the airport with sufficient time for check-in and security. Explore the airport's duty-free shops for last-minute Maldivian souvenirs — local honey, lacquerware, and handicrafts make great gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives with a lifetime of honeymoon memories. Reflect on 13 incredible days of snorkeling, romance, luxury, and adventure in one of the world's most beautiful destinations.

meals.breakfast: Final buffet breakfast at the resort — savor every bite of the tropical spread one last time
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort before departure or at the airport — keep it simple with a sandwich and fresh juice (approx. USD 15–25 per person)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or dinner at the departure airport depending on flight schedule

day_by_day.notes: Checkout time is typically 12:00 noon — confirm with the resort. Ask about late checkout options if your flight is in the evening (may incur an additional fee). Ensure all resort charges, excursion fees, and extras are settled before checkout. Exchange contact details with any resort staff who made your stay special — a small gratuity is always appreciated in the Maldives.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on an exclusive private dhoni boat cruise at sunset, where you can spot spinner dolphins dancing in the golden waters. Sip champagne with your partner as the sky turns shades of orange and pink, creating an unforgettable romantic moment on the Indian Ocean.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant house reefs and coral gardens teeming with sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to the most pristine underwater spots across multiple reef systems, perfect for couples who love marine life.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' spa experience at a glass-walled underwater treatment room, where you can watch colorful fish glide past while enjoying traditional Maldivian massages using coconut oil and local botanicals. The ultimate luxury honeymoon pampering session.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded white sandbank in the middle of the turquoise lagoon, where a personal chef prepares a gourmet Maldivian seafood feast just for two. Dine barefoot on fresh grilled lobster, tuna curry, and tropical fruits surrounded by nothing but ocean.
experiences.location: Veligandu Island, North Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village & Bodu Beru Night
experiences.description: Visit the local island of Maafushi to experience authentic Maldivian culture — explore traditional fishing villages, visit a local mosque, try handmade lacquerwork crafts, and taste street-style short eats like bajiya and gulha. End the evening watching the hypnotic Bodu Beru drum dance performance under the stars.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Meet your dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort concierge at the arrivals hall for a seamless VIP transfer. Board your private speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Upon arrival, enjoy a private welcome ceremony with chilled champagne, fresh flower garlands, and a personal butler orientation of your Beachfront villa. Settle in and unwind.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable
meals.lunch: Not applicable
meals.dinner: A curated late-night welcome amenity platter awaits in your villa — chilled Moët & Chandon, artisan cheese board, tropical fruits, and Maldivian sweet bites arranged by your butler.

day_by_day.notes: Arrival after 22:30. No excursions or activities scheduled. Butler will provide full resort orientation and ensure the villa is stocked with preferred beverages and snacks pre-requested during booking. Early rest recommended to prepare for the days ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Take your first steps onto your private beachfront terrace and soak in the panoramic Indian Ocean views. Enjoy a lavish in-villa breakfast served by your personal butler as the sun rises over the lagoon. After breakfast, take a gentle orientation stroll along the resort's pristine beach and explore the overwater walkways.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's infinity pool for a relaxed afternoon. Your butler arranges a poolside cabana with chilled towels, fresh coconuts, and a curated cocktail menu. Explore the resort's house reef with complimentary snorkeling gear provided — your first glimpse of the vibrant marine life just steps from your villa. Snorkel at your own pace along the shallow reef edge.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's signature overwater fine-dining restaurant. Enjoy a candlelit table suspended above the glowing lagoon, featuring a tasting menu of modern Maldivian cuisine — fresh-caught tuna tartare, lobster bisque, and grilled reef fish paired with a curated wine selection. After dinner, stroll back along the lit jetty under a canopy of stars.

meals.breakfast: In-villa butler-served breakfast: freshly squeezed tropical juices, eggs Benedict, Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut), pastries, and fresh fruit platters.
meals.lunch: Light poolside dining at the resort's beach bar — grilled prawn skewers, avocado salad, and chilled rosé.
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Signature Overwater Restaurant — 5-course tasting menu with Indian Ocean seafood and sommelier-paired wines.

day_by_day.notes: This is a gentle acclimatization day. No off-resort excursions. Encourage guests to rest and explore the resort at leisure. Butler should confirm dietary preferences and allergies for the duration of the stay today.

day_by_day.morning: Begin your first guided snorkeling adventure with the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari. A certified marine biologist guide leads you through the resort's pristine house reef and surrounding coral gardens. Encounter sea turtles gliding through fan corals, reef sharks patrolling the drop-off, vibrant schools of parrotfish and angelfish, and if lucky, a graceful manta ray. Premium snorkeling equipment including prescription masks is provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the villa for a light lunch, then spend the afternoon at the resort's overwater spa for individual treatments. Choose from a Maldivian coconut oil massage, deep tissue therapy, or a rejuvenating facial using locally sourced marine botanicals. Relax in the spa's private infinity plunge pool overlooking the ocean afterward.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic sunset cocktail hour on your private beachfront terrace — your butler sets up a dedicated sunset bar with champagne, canapés, and a fresh flower arrangement. As darkness falls, dine at the resort's beach grill restaurant, where whole lobster, wagyu beef skewers, and fresh catch of the day are grilled over open flames on the sand.

meals.breakfast: Resort main restaurant buffet breakfast — live cooking stations, fresh tropical fruits, Maldivian breakfast specialties, and artisan coffee bar.
meals.lunch: Light in-villa lunch: grilled fish tacos, tropical fruit salad, and freshly pressed juices.
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Beach Grill — open-flame dining on the sand with premium seafood and grilled meats, paired with a curated cocktail and wine menu.

day_by_day.notes: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari is best done in the morning when visibility is at its peak and marine activity is highest. Sunscreen should be reef-safe. Spa appointments should be pre-booked through the butler the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Indulge in the extraordinary Underwater Spa Treatment for Two. Be escorted to the resort's iconic glass-walled underwater treatment room, where the ocean floor becomes your backdrop. Enjoy a synchronized couples' massage as manta rays, reef fish, and sea turtles glide silently past the glass panels. This 90-minute experience includes aromatherapy oils, a post-treatment champagne toast, and a personalized couples' wellness ritual.
day_by_day.afternoon: After your spa morning, enjoy a private catamaran sailing experience on the resort's lagoon. Your captain navigates the crystal-clear waters while you lounge on the net deck with chilled drinks. Spot colorful reef fish through the transparent hull panels. Swim and snorkel from the catamaran at a secluded lagoon spot away from other guests.
day_by_day.evening: Dine under the stars with a private in-villa dinner. Your butler coordinates with the resort's executive chef to deliver a bespoke 4-course dinner to your beachfront terrace — complete with candles, rose petals, a dedicated server, and a live acoustic guitar serenade. Menu highlights include butter-poached Maldivian lobster and dark chocolate fondant with vanilla ice cream.

meals.breakfast: In-villa butler breakfast: tropical smoothie bowls, smoked salmon bagels, freshly baked croissants, and Maldivian herbal teas.
meals.lunch: Light catamaran deck lunch: gourmet sandwiches, chilled prawns, tropical fruit platter, and sparkling water and rosé.
meals.dinner: Private in-villa beachfront dinner — bespoke 4-course chef's menu with wine pairing and live acoustic guitar.

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Spa Treatment for Two must be booked well in advance as it is the resort's most sought-after experience with limited daily slots. Confirm booking through the butler on Day 2. The private in-villa dinner setup requires 24-hour advance notice.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on the Private Sandbank Picnic Dining experience. Your personal butler and a private speedboat captain whisk you away across the turquoise lagoon to an untouched white sandbank surrounded by nothing but ocean. A fully dressed picnic setup awaits — linen tablecloth, fresh flowers, chilled champagne, and a gourmet spread of Maldivian-inspired delicacies. Snorkel directly from the sandbank in the crystal-clear shallows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon at your leisure. Explore the resort's water sports center — try stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking, or a guided glass-bottom kayak tour over the reef. Alternatively, simply relax in your private villa pool with a cocktail and a good book as your butler attends to every need.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy pre-dinner cocktails at the resort's overwater bar — sip craft Maldivian-inspired cocktails (coconut arrack mojitos, passion fruit martinis) as the sun dips below the horizon, painting the sky in vivid oranges and pinks. Dine at the resort's Japanese-Maldivian fusion restaurant, featuring omakase sushi, sashimi of freshly caught tuna, and wagyu tataki.

meals.breakfast: Included in the Private Sandbank Picnic experience — freshly baked pastries, tropical fruits, Maldivian coconut flatbread, and chilled juices served on the sandbank.
meals.lunch: Gourmet sandbank picnic: Maldivian lobster rolls, chilled seafood platter, artisan cheeses, and Moët & Chandon.
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Japanese-Maldivian Fusion Restaurant — omakase menu with premium sake and Japanese whisky pairing.

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic timing depends on tidal conditions — your butler will confirm the ideal departure time (typically mid-morning around 9:30–10:00 AM). Weather permitting, this is one of the most memorable experiences of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, romantic morning entirely in your villa. Wake up naturally, enjoy a butler-prepared in-villa breakfast on your terrace, and take a private sunrise yoga session on the beach arranged by the resort's wellness team. Your personal yoga instructor guides a gentle couples' sunrise flow as the Indian Ocean shimmers in the early light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in a guided big-game fishing excursion on a private chartered boat. Head out into deeper Maldivian waters in search of yellowfin tuna, mahi-mahi, and barracuda. Your catch can be brought back to the resort's kitchen and prepared as a personalized dinner by the executive chef — a true farm-to-table (sea-to-table) luxury experience.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your catch with a bespoke 'Catch & Cook' private dinner at the resort's chef's table. The executive chef prepares your freshly caught fish with a Maldivian spice rub, served alongside reef curry, coconut rice, and pickled mango. Enjoy the intimate chef's table setting with a behind-the-scenes kitchen experience and personalized wine pairing.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast on the terrace: eggs any style, fresh tropical fruits, Maldivian roshi (flatbread) with coconut sambal, and specialty coffee.
meals.lunch: Light onboard fishing boat lunch: gourmet wraps, fresh fruit, energy bars, and chilled beverages provided by the resort.
meals.dinner: Private Chef's Table 'Catch & Cook' Dinner — your own fresh catch prepared by the executive chef with premium wine pairing.

day_by_day.notes: Big-game fishing excursions are subject to weather and sea conditions. The resort's water sports team will confirm departure times. Guests should apply strong sunscreen and wear a hat on the open boat. The Catch & Cook dinner must be pre-arranged with the resort's culinary team.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a full luxury spa day. Begin with a traditional Maldivian Javanese Lulur body scrub — a royal treatment using turmeric, rice powder, and jasmine to exfoliate and illuminate the skin. Follow with a 60-minute warm stone massage and a nourishing coconut hair treatment. The spa's outdoor treatment pavilion overlooks the ocean for ultimate serenity.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a private resort island exploration by bicycle — the resort provides premium bicycles to cycle along the island's perimeter path through lush tropical vegetation. Stop at the resort's organic herb and vegetable garden for a guided tour with the head chef, learning about locally grown ingredients used in the resort's cuisine. End at the secluded adults-only beach for a quiet afternoon swim.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight, enjoy the Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise. Board your exclusive private dhoni boat as the golden hour begins. Cruise along the outer reef as pods of spinner dolphins leap and dance alongside the bow in the warm sunset light. Sip champagne and enjoy a canapé selection on deck as the sky transforms into brilliant shades of amber and violet. Return to the resort after dark for a relaxed dinner.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast with live cooking stations — pancakes, freshly baked breads, Maldivian fish curry, tropical smoothies, and artisan coffee.
meals.lunch: Beachside light lunch at the resort's adults-only beach club — Mediterranean mezze platter, fresh salads, and chilled white wine.
meals.dinner: Casual resort dining at the overwater lounge bar — premium tapas-style sharing plates, fresh sashimi, and craft cocktails post-dolphin cruise.

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise typically departs around 5:00–5:30 PM to align with sunset. Spinner dolphins are most active in the late afternoon in Maldivian waters. Bring a light layer for the boat as it can be breezy on the open water at dusk.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a second, deeper Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — this time focusing on the outer reef wall and a nearby coral pinnacle known for large pelagic encounters. Your marine biologist guide leads you to a drift snorkel along a gentle current, where eagle rays, white-tip reef sharks, and enormous Napoleon wrasse are frequently spotted. A private boat supports the excursion for safety and comfort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the villa for a leisurely afternoon. Indulge in a private mixology masterclass on your beachfront terrace — the resort's head bartender visits your villa to teach you how to craft authentic Maldivian cocktails using local arrack, fresh coconut, and tropical fruits. Create your own signature honeymoon cocktail recipe to take home.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic overwater dinner at the resort's glass-floor restaurant, where the illuminated reef below glows with bioluminescent plankton after dark. The tasting menu features a seven-course celebration of Indian Ocean flavors — from smoked reef fish amuse-bouche to passion fruit soufflé — with a sommelier guiding a full wine pairing journey.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast: freshly pressed green juices, granola with Maldivian honey, tropical fruit platter, and eggs Benedict with smoked tuna.
meals.lunch: Post-snorkel light lunch at the resort's beach café — grilled calamari, watermelon and feta salad, and fresh coconut water.
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Glass-Floor Overwater Restaurant — 7-course tasting menu with full sommelier wine pairing.

day_by_day.notes: The glass-floor overwater restaurant is the resort's most exclusive dining venue. Reservations should be secured by Day 6 at the latest. Smart casual dress code applies — linen shirts and elegant resort wear recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Visit the local island of Maafushi for the Maldivian Cultural Village & Bodu Beru Night experience. Depart by speedboat mid-morning. Explore the traditional fishing village — visit a local school, a traditional boat-building workshop (dhoni yard), a handcraft weaving demonstration, and a local mosque. Sample authentic Maldivian street food including hedhikaa (short eats) and sweet bondi.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the cultural immersion with a guided cooking class at a local Maldivian home — learn to prepare traditional mas riha (tuna curry), garudhiya (fish broth), and coconut flatbread. Enjoy the meal you've prepared for lunch with your hosts. Browse the local market for handmade lacquerware, woven mats, and Maldivian jewelry as unique souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the electrifying Bodu Beru night performance — a traditional Maldivian drumming and dance ceremony performed by local artists in authentic costumes. The rhythmic drumbeats and energetic dancing build to a hypnotic crescendo. Return to the resort by private speedboat and enjoy a nightcap at the overwater bar under the stars.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast before departure: fresh tropical fruits, yogurt parfait, Maldivian mas huni, and specialty coffee.
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian home-cooked meal prepared during the cooking class on Maafushi — tuna curry, coconut rice, garudhiya, and fresh roshi.
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort's overwater bar and lounge upon return — premium charcuterie board, fresh oysters, and craft cocktails.

day_by_day.notes: Maafushi is a local inhabited island — guests should dress respectfully (cover shoulders and knees) when visiting the village and mosque. This is a wonderful opportunity for authentic cultural connection beyond the resort bubble. Speedboat transfer is approximately 20–30 minutes each way.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a complete rest and rejuvenation morning. Sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed served by your butler, and spend time on your private beachfront terrace. Take a slow swim in your villa's private plunge pool or wade into the warm lagoon directly from your beach. This is a free morning to simply be present and enjoy the paradise around you.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in a private guided freediving introduction session with the resort's certified freediving instructor. Learn breath-holding techniques, equalization, and safe descent methods in the shallow lagoon. Progress to a guided freedive along the house reef — an entirely new perspective on the underwater world compared to snorkeling, floating weightlessly among the coral.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the penultimate phase of your honeymoon with a private beach bonfire dinner. Your butler and the resort team set up an intimate bonfire on a secluded stretch of beach — driftwood fire, lanterns, rose petals in the sand, and a dedicated private chef and server. Enjoy a premium barbecue menu of whole grilled lobster, wagyu beef tenderloin, and decadent desserts under a sky blazing with stars.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast in bed — full English-Maldivian fusion spread: smoked fish, pastries, tropical fruits, eggs, and fresh juices served on a decorative tray.
meals.lunch: Poolside in-villa lunch: cold lobster salad, avocado toast with caviar, and chilled Chablis.
meals.dinner: Private beach bonfire dinner — premium barbecue with whole lobster, wagyu tenderloin, and champagne toast under the stars.

day_by_day.notes: The private beach bonfire dinner is a signature romantic experience. Coordinate with the butler at least 48 hours in advance to arrange the setup, menu preferences, and any special romantic touches such as personalized messages in the sand or floating flower arrangements.

day_by_day.morning: Take a sunrise kayaking expedition around the island's perimeter — the early morning light on the lagoon is magical, with glassy calm water and the possibility of spotting baby reef sharks in the shallows. Return for a leisurely breakfast and a final visit to the resort's spa for a relaxing couples' Hammam ritual — steam, exfoliation, and a gentle massage.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon on a private chartered sunset sailing dhoni excursion to a remote snorkeling spot only accessible by boat. Your captain anchors at a pristine coral bommie teeming with marine life rarely seen by other visitors. Snorkel at your own pace with your guide, then relax on deck with chilled drinks as you drift back toward the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Your second Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise experience — a repeat of one of the trip's most magical moments, this time with a deeper appreciation and familiarity with the ocean surroundings. Sip vintage Krug champagne on deck as spinner dolphins escort your dhoni through the golden-pink dusk. Return for a final grand dinner at the resort's signature overwater restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast — full spread with live cooking stations, fresh juices, Maldivian specialties, and artisan coffee.
meals.lunch: On-boat lunch during the private dhoni excursion — fresh sashimi, sushi rolls, tropical fruit, and chilled sake.
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Signature Overwater Restaurant — à la carte menu with premium seafood selections and vintage wine list.

day_by_day.notes: Day 11 is designed as a 'greatest hits' day revisiting the trip's most beloved activities. Confirm the second dolphin cruise booking early in the trip as slots are limited. Encourage guests to bring an underwater camera or GoPro for the snorkeling excursion.

day_by_day.morning: Wake early for a final sunrise snorkeling session on the house reef — the early morning light creates extraordinary visibility and the reef is at its most peaceful before the day begins. Take photographs and video of your favorite underwater spots as a final memory. Return for a leisurely villa breakfast and begin relaxed packing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a final indulgent afternoon spa treatment — choose from a deep relaxation massage, a brightening facial, or a full body wrap using Maldivian volcanic clay. Afterward, lounge at the resort's infinity pool with your favorite cocktails, take a final swim in the lagoon, and simply absorb the beauty of your surroundings one last time.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a special 'Farewell Dinner' arranged by the resort — your butler coordinates with the culinary team to recreate your favorite dish from the trip alongside a new surprise course.
